attchmntText: COSMO FIRST LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding Demise of  Mr. Hoshang Noshirwan Sinor , Non- Executive Director of the company on November 12, 2026.
voiceSummary: Cosmo First Limited intimates the cessation of directorship of Mr. Hoshang Noshirwan Sinor, DIN 00074905, Non-Executive Non-Independent Director, consequent to his demise on November 12, 2026. The company filed this notice under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations. The Board conveyed condolences to the bereaved family. The disclosure was submitted to BSE and NSE on November 13, 2026.

attchmntText: COSMO FIRST LIMITED has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Cosmo First Limited filed a transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on November 04, 2026. Consolidated sales for the September 2026 quarter reached Rs. 1,388 crore, a 51% year-on-year increase. EBITDA grew 38% to Rs. 177 crore, including a Rs. 24.8 crore write-back from US customs duty refunds and a Rs. 7 crore inventory loss. Excluding these items, EBITDA was Rs. 159 crore. The company adopted the new tax regime for FY27, expecting an effective tax rate between -6% and -7%. Net debt reduced to Rs. 1,057 crore. Management highlighted strong growth in specialty chemicals, rigid packaging, and consumer verticals Zigly and Cosmo Consumer. Capacity additions for specialty films and barrier sheets are planned for the second half of FY27. Renewable power is expected to meet two-thirds of power requirements by next year, saving Rs. 25 crore to Rs. 30 crore annually.
